Gemischte Wiederholung A

Fragen aus verschiedenen Units. Der graue Hinweis zeigt, aus welcher Übung die Frage stammt.

Choose the correct answer

1. costs have dropped, countries are transitioning Cause & Effect in Academic Writing

2. Chinese businesspeople wanting something in return Building Relationships — Reading

3. A good paraphrase is roughly the Paraphrasing & Summarizing

4. Personal stories rather than systematic research Critical Thinking & Evaluating Sources
